argument:
The bear is correct that leverage and year-ago margin comparisons prevent a clean buy. My narrower counterpoint is that sequential margin improvement and debt below the March observation are observable changes, while the rising revenue series and positive earnings contradict a simple collapse narrative.

Those observations do not prove acquisition returns or a price discount. I therefore concede that trend confirmation is absent and the bullish thesis remains conditional on operational recovery continuing. Missing sentiment adds no evidence either way. Eaton is a recovery watch candidate rather than an immediate reversal trade justified by how far it has fallen.
key_points: Conditional watch rather than assumed cheapness
rebuttal_to_previous: Concede present entry is unconfirmed; distinguish observed sequential improvement from an unsupported claim that all owner economics have repaired.
